scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:env: test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env; test -f frontend/.env || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env; mkdir -p backend/data
